PUBLIC SERVICES COMMITTEE
MINUTES

A meeting of the Public Services Committee was held on Tuesday, December 6, 2022, in
Committee Room 104 and via electronic meeting, starting at 12:00 p.m. Those in attendance were
as follows:

COMMITTEE MEMBERS: Bryan Cook, Chairman, Pete Laybourn, Dr. Mark Rinne and Tom
Segrave,

(trp ROR SERS RE A AAS
AGENDA ITEMS

Dr. Rinne arrived at 12:02 p.m. during discussion on item #8.

8 ORDINANCE ~3" READING - Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from P Public to CB Community Business
for land located south of Missile Drive, east of I-25.

Mr. Laybourn moved to approve on 3 and final reading, seconded by Mr. Segrave. Motion
carried by unanimous voice vote.

Seth Lloyd, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report. Shane Hanson, Steil
Surveying, was available for questions.

10. ORDINANCE ~2"* READING ~ Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, land
located west of Van Buren Avenue, north of Dell Range Boulevard. (SPONSOR ~ MR.
COOK)

Mr. Segrave moved to approve on 2"! reading, seconded by Mr. Laybourn, Motion carried by
unanimous voice vote.

Seth Lloyd, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report and Brandon Swain,
developer, provided additional information. Committee members Mr. Laybourn and Mr. Segrave
commented on the item.

11. ORDINANCE ~2" READING — Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from County AR Agricultural Residential to
NR-3 Neighborhood Residential - High Density for land located west of Van Buren
Avenue, north of Dell Range Boulevard. (SPONSOR - MR. COOK)

Mr. Segrave moved to approve on 2" reading, seconded by Mr. Laybourn. Motion carried by
unanimous voice vote.
